meta.title: SSO Authentication: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Attempt SSO Authentication and verify it is refused or not offered for the non-Tenant Admin
Repeat the SSO Authentication attempt as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available
Compare the two role outcomes and record any deliberate RBAC grant to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Enterprise tenant; Attempt SSO Authentication and verify it is refused or not offered for the non-Tenant Admin; Repeat the SSO Authentication attempt as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available; Compare the two role outcomes and record any deliberate RBAC grant to additional roles

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin and Tenant Admin users on the same Enterprise tenant, attempt SSO Authentication for each, and compare whether the action is refused or unavailable for the non-admin and available for the Tenant Admin

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform role-specific authentication or observe the SSO Authentication control and its RBAC outcome.
Provides a final screen assertion if the tester leaves the SSO Authentication control or result visible, but does not establish the role-specific behavior.
